settings.heading: Every morning, the mirror says the same thing
settings.body:
The lines across your forehead and between your brows. The crinkles at the corners of your eyes. The smile lines that stay long after the smile is gone. They make you look tired or upset, even on your best days.

The creams promised to help and didn't touch them. And needles? Between the price, the upkeep and the thought of a frozen look, that was never really on the table.
settings.kicker: There's a simpler way to wake up to smoother-looking skin.

settings.title: Apply before bed
settings.text: Press each patch onto clean, dry skin, from the center outward. All five take about a minute.

settings.title: Sleep
settings.text: The soft silicone holds your skin smooth through the night and seals in your skin's own moisture. No actives, nothing absorbed.

settings.title: Peel and glow
settings.text: Peel them off in the morning to visibly smoother-looking skin. Then just clean and reuse, night after night.

settings.heading: Hold + hydrate, while you sleep
settings.text: While you sleep, your skin folds and loses moisture. Each patch does two simple things all night: it holds the skin surface smooth, and it seals in moisture, so lines look softer and "ironed out" by morning.

settings.heading: Honest expectations
settings.body:
Night one: peel the patches off to smoother-looking skin. The effect is strongest in the first hours of the morning.

Every night after: make it your one-minute ritual. Results are visible in the morning and are strongest when you use the patches regularly. Deep-set lines soften less than fine ones, and results vary from person to person.
settings.kicker: Look rested. Still look like you.

settings.heading: Think in cost per night
settings.text: One reusable set, many mornings. Here's how the options actually stack up.
settings.note: Injectable costs shown are typical published US prices per visit. We're not comparing results, just what it takes to keep going.

settings.title: Start clean and dry
settings.text: No serum, lotion or oil underneath. The patches grip best on fully dry skin. Oily skin? Pat dry first.

settings.title: Smooth from the center out
settings.text: Press each patch on so it lies flat with no air pockets. Around the eyes, don't stretch the skin.

settings.title: Wear them overnight
settings.text: 6–8 hours is the sweet spot. Side sleeper? Press the edges once more before lights out.

settings.title: Peel, clean, reuse
settings.text: Peel off gently, clean each patch after use and store it on its backing film so it's ready for tonight.

settings.heading: Two minutes to the perfect fit
settings.text: Most "it fell off" stories come down to skincare under the patch. A little prep fixes that. New to silicone patches? Try one for an hour first, and stop if your skin feels irritated.

settings.question: Will the patches stay on all night?
settings.answer: Applied to clean, fully dry skin (no serum or oil underneath), the patches are made to stay in place overnight. Smooth each one from the center outward so it sits flat, and press the edges once more if you sleep on your side.

settings.question: Where do the four crescents go?
settings.answer: Wherever you notice lines most: under your eyes, at the outer corners for crow's feet, or along your smile lines. Mix and match from night to night.

settings.question: How many times can I reuse them?
settings.answer: Many nights with proper care. Clean each patch after use and store it on its backing film. How long they last depends on your skin prep and care routine.

settings.question: Are they safe under my eyes?
settings.answer: The crescents are shaped for the delicate under-eye area. Apply without stretching the skin, and stop if you feel irritation. Don't use on broken or irritated skin.

settings.question: Will they irritate my skin or cause breakouts?
settings.answer: The patches are soft silicone with no actives; nothing is absorbed into your skin. Keep them clean between uses. If your skin is sensitive, try one for an hour first.

settings.question: Can I use them with retinol or tretinoin?
settings.answer: Use the patches on your non-retinoid nights, or check with your dermatologist. Never apply a patch over freshly applied actives.

settings.question: How long do results last?
settings.answer: The smoother look is strongest in the morning and fades through the day, which is normal for every patch of this kind. Used regularly, mornings keep starting smoother.

settings.question: Does it work on deep lines?
settings.answer: You'll see smoother-looking softening. Fine lines respond most; deep-set lines soften less. We'd rather tell you that now than surprise you later.
